# Sprout Tech original campus

The campus uses original 3D architecture, furniture, landscape layout, signs,
interface textures, camera animation, river path, articulated research robot arm,
and film sound design. The animated forest features dynamic traveling wind-wave
canopy swaying, ground-level breeze-reactive ferns, fluttering forest foliage
particles, atmospheric volumetric sunbeams, and floating forest spores.
The interactive walk loads these web-ready 3D models:

- “Robot” by Bake3D (https://bake3d.ai/free-3d-models), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Local original `bake3d-robot-animated.glb` from https://bake3d.ai/samples/free/bake3d-robot-animated.glb. Mesh and textures unchanged; scaled and positioned for the lab. Five authored skeletal clips: Walk, Run, Idle, Look around, and Intro. Interactive motion blends the source clips.
- Industrial Microscope by Lukas Walzer, Poly Haven: https://polyhaven.com/a/industrial_microscope (CC0). Original glTF mesh and 1K diffuse, normal, and packed AO/roughness/metalness textures; stored in `microscope/`.
- Furniture Kit by Kenney: https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit (CC0 1.0). Desk chair, stools, laptops, bookcase, books, drawer cabinets, specimen refrigerator, and potted plants. GLB distributions from https://github.com/Hidencod/tge-assets/tree/main/packs/furniture-kit; stored as `kenney-*.glb`.
- Pine Tree 01: https://polyhaven.com/a/pine_tree_01
- Fir Tree 01: https://polyhaven.com/a/fir_tree_01
- Tree Small 02: https://polyhaven.com/a/tree_small_02
- Xanderklinge forest stream panorama: https://polyhaven.com/a/xanderklinge
- Low-poly Sci-fi Drone: https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/low-poly-sci-fi-drone-c2568e13 (CC0)
- Flying Butterfly: CDmir and TinyWorlds, https://opengameart.org/content/butterfly-animated (CC0; rigged and animated)
- Hummingbird: Gobkit free 3D assets, https://github.com/Ariescar/gobkit-free-assets (CC0 1.0; rigged and animated; local GLB from https://gobkit.com/freebies/birds/Hummingbird.glb)
- Animated Garden Fountain: https://pixor.art/library/elements/fountain/ (CC0; animated GLB)
- Research lab glassware and equipment: MilkAndBanana via ARISE, https://github.com/aamodpaudel/ARISE-AI-Powered-Virtual-Laboratory-for-Accessibility-Microsoft-ICJ-Winner- (CC0)
- RobotExpressive research assistants: Tomás Laulhé, modified by Don McCurdy, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/dev/examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive (CC0 1.0; 14 authored skeletal clips: Wave, ThumbsUp, Dance, Jump, Yes, No, Walking, Running, Sitting, Standing, Punch, WalkJump, Death, Idle). Scaled and stationed in the Research Lab and Build Studio with real-time skeletal cross-fading, interactive HUD action triggers, and contextual walkthrough gestures.
- License: https://polyhaven.com/about-contact

The film is an animated 3D walkthrough, not AI-generated photorealistic footage.
It is rendered from the same scene source used by the interactive website.

Interactive rendering: Three.js, copyright its authors, MIT License.
Vendored Three.js r160 GLTFLoader and SkeletonUtils: MIT License.
Offline film rendering: Blender. Encoding: FFmpeg.

The Fern & Form and Fieldnotes exhibits are illustrative studio concepts;
they do not represent commissioned client work.

No stock video footage is used; the campus film is rendered from the original scene.
